EXPTRACK 1.5.0

Install EXPTRACK-1.5.0.apk over your existing app; do not uninstall.

Adds Loans: borrowed amounts, outstanding totals, partial and full repayments, and cleared history. Money received increases available cash; repayments reduce it. Outstanding debt is shown separately. Choose Existing debt only when no new cash should be recorded. Existing Loan received entries appear automatically without double counting.

Records and account sync use the existing ledger and are preserved when updating with this APK.
